objective: Reconcile observed parcels against an inbound manifest and reject normalized identities reused across supported fields.
acceptance: identity comparison normalizes case, compatibility characters, whitespace, and hyphens
the same identity reused across tracking_id, barcode, or parcel_uid fails closed
an optional inbound manifest rejects missing, unexpected, or mismatched parcels before manipulation
the independent verifier distinguishes missing manifest evidence from a manifest mismatch
place actions and dashboard replay expose manifest and identity guard outcomes without storing recipient data
evidence: planner tests for cross-field duplicates and manifest mismatch
world-model tests for missing and contradictory manifest evidence
scripted parcel log with manifest guard metadata
stop_conditions: a manifest contains recipient names, addresses, or other unnecessary personal data
conditional execution would require a new contract
mobile navigation or parcel-locker access is requested
scripted observations would be presented as physical sensor evidence
